There are countless MagSafe battery options on the market, and I myself may have already bought most of them. The recently released TESSAN AERO 5000 has caught my eye because it is genuinely ultra-thin and features a titanium metal casing. It also adopts a new battery technology that can reduce heat generation and improve overall safety. After reading through the full spec sheet, I think it might be one of the most impressive products in this year's MagSafe battery market, and I can't wait to try it out for myself.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers will take a look at the latest and greatest products in the MagSafe and wireless charging industry, helping you get the most out of your wireless charging-compatible Apple devices.

Titanium Body and Ultra-Thin Design

TESSAN has crafted the AERO 5000 to be just 6.9mm thick, roughly the thickness of three credit cards stacked together. The design goal was for it not to feel like 'carrying a chunky battery' in your pocket, but rather more like carrying a MagSafe wallet.

Beyond the size, the material they chose for the body is what truly caught my eye. TESSAN used iPhone-grade titanium alloy for the battery's back plate, which is a thoughtful detail. Standing out in the battery market is genuinely hard — most of the time it's just a race to the bottom on price or a competition to pack in the largest capacity.

On the battery front, TESSAN uses a pure-cobalt semi-solid-state battery core called SolidSafe. Traditional batteries typically contain highly flammable liquid, whereas TESSAN's new structure significantly reduces heat buildup, and even if the battery suffers severe physical impact, it can prevent thermal runaway. Heat is the archenemy of battery health, so any design that can lower temperatures during charging is a major win. It can deliver up to 15W wireless output, or 20W through the USB-C port. Even with a small-capacity battery, having a wired output port is very practical (for example, charging your AirPods, etc.).

TESSAN AERO 5000: Hands-On Impressions

If you want your everyday carry to be as light as possible, the TESSAN AERO 5000 seems to be an outstanding choice. It combines a titanium metal casing with next-generation battery safety technology to effectively control heat generation.

To learn more about the TESSAN AERO 5000, visit the official Tessan website.
